title: Custom Messages
description: Custom join, leave, death, and kill messages for every player.
body:
# CustomMessages

Let every player on your server set their own **custom join, leave, death, and kill messages** — no OP required!

## Features
- 🟢 **Custom join messages** — shown when a player joins
- 🔴 **Custom leave messages** — shown when a player leaves
- 💀 **Custom death messages** — shown when killed by a mob or environment
- ⚔️ **Custom kill messages** — shown when YOU kill another player
- 🔵 **Tab autocomplete** — press Tab to pick from presets instantly
- 🎨 **Color code support** — use & codes in your messages
- 💾 **Persistent** — messages save across restarts

## Commands
| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/customjoin set <message>` | Set your join message |
| `/customleave set <message>` | Set your leave message |
| `/customdeathmessage set <message>` | Set your death message (mobs/environment) |
| `/customkillmessage set <message>` | Set your kill message (PvP) |

## Placeholders
- `{self}` — your name
- `{killer}` — mob or cause that killed you
- `{victim}` — the player you killed

## Requirements
- Paper 1.21.4+
- Java 21+
